author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Northward, an open-world co-op adventure game developed by Yore & Yonder. Players will traverse and explore multiple biomes to overcome challenges, find lost treasure, and make sense of the mystery of a fallen star. Recruit characters across the lands to become crew on the ship, with upgrades to attain, and seek adventure with up to 4 players in co-op. Northward is coming soon to PC (Steam).

title: Northward - Official Reveal Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the PS5 and Xbox Launch Trailer for Darksiders: Warmastered Edition, an enhanced version of the hit third-person action hack-and-slash game developed by Kaiko and Vigil Games. Players will embody the first of the four Horsemen of the Apocalypse as War, who seeks redemption after being falsely accused of setting off the end times. Indulge in the action with enhanced visuals, improved performance, and all previously released content, delivering a definitive experience for modern platforms. Darksiders: Warmastered Edition is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Darksiders: Warmastered Edition - Official PS5 and Xbox Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Spooky Tales, a retro horror anthology game developed by Liminal Road. Hosted by a macabre, undead master of ceremonies with a seriously twisted sense of humor, players will dive into distinct stories that pay homage to classic horror tropes. These stories include everything from bloody 80s slashers and eerie Japanese body horror to modern mascot horror and vintage pulp terror. Spooky Tales is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Spooky Tales - Official Announcement Trailer

description:
Lego Batman: legacy of The Dark Knight is the latest series to get the brick treatment, but where does it fit in a list of the best Lego games? Let's find out!

Lego first made its jump into video games 31 years ago, with LEGO Fun To Build on the Sega Pico, and since then, these colourful Danish bricks have become a genre of their own. From Lego Star Wars to Lego Batman, Lego City Undercover and more, these are our Top 10 Lego games of all time.
